nodes.label: Business expenses (Expenses page, direct expenses)
nodes.rationale: Excludes stock purchases and repair costs to avoid double deduction; idempotency key prevents duplicates

nodes.label: Cash drawer movements (sale, cash_out, cash_in)
nodes.rationale: Only recorded cash payments move the drawer; reversals record cash_in instead of deleting

nodes.label: costsCapitalized legacy repairs migration
nodes.rationale: Repairs before 2026-10-17 on stock devices kept costs in device cost so history is unchanged

nodes.label: server/src/lib/profit.ts shared profit functions
nodes.rationale: Every screen and report uses the same functions so the numbers agree

nodes.label: Sales revenue / net sales / sales gross profit / COGS
nodes.norm_label: sales revenue / net sales / sales gross profit / cogs

nodes.label: Supplier invoices and payments (remaining balance, status, statement)
nodes.norm_label: supplier invoices and payments (remaining balance, status, statement)
nodes.rationale: Stock purchases counted in COGS when sold, never as direct expenses; invoice takes over purchase order debt so a purchase is counted once

nodes.label: Whole-business profit (gross profit, direct expenses, net profit, margin)
nodes.norm_label: whole-business profit (gross profit, direct expenses, net profit, margin)

nodes.label: Systeme Maroc (reference app, Vue 3 + Vite SPA)
nodes.norm_label: systeme maroc (reference app, vue 3 + vite spa)

nodes.label: GET /stores/:storeId/caisse cash drawer response
nodes.rationale: Amount always positive, direction from type; creator leaks refreshToken (bug not reproduced)

nodes.label: Repair status lifecycle (pending -> in_progress -> completed -> delivered)
nodes.norm_label: repair status lifecycle (pending -> in_progress -> completed -> delivered)

nodes.label: Business's own devices as TAC source (learned on save)
nodes.norm_label: business's own devices as tac source (learned on save)

nodes.label: Form fill rules per TAC record (catalogue model, model number, aka, brand only)
nodes.norm_label: form fill rules per tac record (catalogue model, model number, aka, brand only)

nodes.label: Osmocom TAC database (CC BY-SA 3.0)
nodes.rationale: Free but incomplete for recent iPhones/Galaxys; chosen over paid GSMA/51Degrees and per-call APIs that need the full IMEI

nodes.label: TAC lookup (GET /phone-seller/sold-units/tac/:tac)
nodes.rationale: Only the 8-digit TAC is looked up on CaissePro's own server; full IMEI never leaves; nothing overwritten silently

nodes.label: IMEI identification tests and Osmocom import fix (tac.test.ts)
nodes.norm_label: imei identification tests and osmocom import fix (tac.test.ts)

nodes.label: labelRenderer.js / labelContext() / deviceDisplayName() sticker pipeline
nodes.rationale: One renderer and one naming function so preview, modal, bulk and product labels agree; settings.printingSettings is the single control

nodes.label: Arabic RTL sidebar fix and mixed Arabic/Latin isolation
nodes.norm_label: arabic rtl sidebar fix and mixed arabic/latin isolation
nodes.rationale: Custom [dir=rtl] rule outranked lg:translate-x-0; replaced with Tailwind rtl: variant; amounts wrapped in LTR isolates

nodes.label: Colour design tokens (--c-brand, --c-neutral, --c-ink...) mapped to Tailwind
nodes.norm_label: colour design tokens (--c-brand, --c-neutral, --c-ink...) mapped to tailwind
nodes.rationale: Mapping Tailwind colour names to tokens lets existing classes follow the palette without markup changes; AA contrast

nodes.label: Typography: Inter + IBM Plex Sans Arabic, tabular figures
nodes.norm_label: typography: inter + ibm plex sans arabic, tabular figures
nodes.rationale: One font stack so mixed Arabic/Latin lines keep each script in its own designed face

nodes.label: Axios HTTP client with Bearer token and 401/403 interceptors
nodes.norm_label: axios http client with bearer token and 401/403 interceptors

nodes.label: Search query pipeline (300ms debounce, 3 parallel requests, units->products->customers)
nodes.norm_label: search query pipeline (300ms debounce, 3 parallel requests, units->products->customers)

nodes.label: Systeme Maroc inventory of pages, modules and APIs
nodes.norm_label: systeme maroc inventory of pages, modules and apis

nodes.label: Observed repairs and cash drawer on live trial account
nodes.norm_label: observed repairs and cash drawer on live trial account

nodes.label: Arabic terminology glossary
nodes.rationale: One Arabic term per concept in Moroccan business usage; Latin codes, brands and DH amounts stay Latin; no right/left wording since layout is mirrored

nodes.label: Device catalogue data file (device-catalog.txt)
nodes.rationale: One model per line: [type] sections, Brand: headers, Model|year|storage|colour|ram

nodes.label: Repair costs are not business expenses
nodes.norm_label: repair costs are not business expenses
nodes.rationale: Costs belong to the repair and are deducted from its price only, so they cannot be deducted twice

nodes.label: Repair realization rule (realizedAt: completed/delivered AND fully paid)
nodes.norm_label: repair realization rule (realizedat: completed/delivered and fully paid)
nodes.rationale: Unpaid or cancelled repairs never count; realization date drives every report
